inputs.text: Photorealistic night landscape photographed from inside a limestone cave, looking toward the cave mouth in the background. Beyond the opening, rugged distant mountains fade through layers of low fog. Cold blue moonlight enters the cave, cinematic directional lighting with natural shadow detail. Wet pale limestone walls and ceiling, rough mineral layers, eroded rock, visible water droplets hanging and dripping from the ceiling. Shallow foreground puddles reflect blue light, tiny ripple rings where drops hit water. Believable rock textures, deep focus, realistic exposure, subtle mist outside. Wide horizontal composition, no people, full-frame location photograph.
